treatment_definition.rationale: Original and factored metadata representations of the same transport require separate arm labels, controls normalization, complete-input accounting and selected-view audit.

required_gate_groups.name: immutable_fresh_pair_custody
requirements: Canonical bounded single-trial receipt and native task/job identity; config and preparation bytes bind exact selected frozen archive.
Same frozen runtime/archive/manifest and all metadata helper, runner, independent auditor, CLI provider/generation-policy, benchmark-controls and native owner-context implementations bound.
Prepared task inputs, resource/setup/cache/provider/model/reasoning/CLI controls observed unchanged in native configuration; no historical replay used to certify current preparation.
Distinct native trials retained; no overwrite of old receipts, comparators, audits or prior failure costs.

required_gate_groups.name: requested_and_observed_mode
requirements: Both arms original @1; direct planning and ordinary reply retained in preparation, frozen config, supervisor and native agent metadata.
Only baseline legacy versus treatment common-bindings request may differ under a closed named normalization; transport remains a compared control.
Treatment selection receipt binds source/view/selection and complete native/candidate/selected prompt layers with strict field types and canonical equality.
Treatment must actually select common-bindings@1 for observed-treatment qualification; legacy fallback is retained as an attempted treatment and its full cost is reported.

required_gate_groups.name: native_input_owner_and_restoration
requirements: Existing semantic owner verifies complete current producer inventory, source manifest and admitted context before factoring.
Reconstructed original @1 equals exact pre-transform bytes; fixed projector candidate equals recorded view.
Literal task requirements, source bodies/paths/signatures, native core, verdicts/statuses, unknown fields and prefix/suffix unchanged by representation.
Do not grant currentness, proof, omission, execution, settlement or completion authority to catalog nominations, dry-run census or pure restoration.

Cross-arm counterfactual native coding core, literal suffix, source manifest/populations and complete-input observations are preserved; strict only-metadata-changed verdict requires substantive input equality or a separately named owner-validated normalization.

required_gate_groups.name: complete_initial_input_and_reply_layers
requirements: Independently audit both the undelivered original complete input and actual selected complete input after Doctor/public/workspace/reply layers.
Baseline original transport+Doctor+public+workspace+506 arithmetic binds actual model bytes; treatment selected view+same wrappers+same506 suffix binds actual selected input.
Actual coding_reply_contract binds selected provider input; separate native counterfactual contract binds undelivered baseline.
Both reply layers have identical fixed closed contract fields and generation schema/suffix; native CLI schema hash/bytes and request/validation policy bind actual contract.
Complete byte count and named UTF-8 ceil-div4 proxy must strictly improve for selection; full inputs both within256000B; independent current context auditor verifies actual model SHA/bytes.
Initial model input digest scope is limited; native cumulative usage accounts full session including later tool/model conversation.

required_gate_groups.name: retained_planning_and_native_provider_accounting
requirements: Exactly one admitted planning and one coding llm_router CLI session expected per arm; detect and retain any additional or failed attempts.
Planning generation schema, schema/tempfile/CLI custody, canonical plan scope/evidence/admission and observed direct strategy qualified separately.
Native cumulative input, cached input, output and total integers checked; total=input+output, cache<=input.
Cached input is already included in native input and never added twice; cumulative counters are not summed across snapshots.
Unknown or partial failed usage remains null with observed lower bounds and explicit completeness flags; never zero-filled or silently excluded.
Complete per-phase and total usage covers all attempts, independent of reward/output validation, plus retained campaign cost.

required_gate_groups.name: native_effects_and_interpretation
requirements: Original official verifier reward and native task completion, settlement/STOP and cleanup checked independently.
Report all native effects and failure reasons even if gates fail; do not treat a smaller initial prompt or proxy as total-token efficacy.
A lower complete total on one qualified pair is an observed pair result, not causal or repeatable savings.
Predeclare balanced repeated pair order, outcomes, budget/failure handling and aggregation for repeatability; retain adverse/fallback/cost results.

offline_census_boundary.may_support: Representation and active-owner preparation viability under its exact declared source/index/plan/wrapper scope.
cannot_support: Current preparation certified from historical replay.
An actual retained LLM planning session executed or avoided when the context uses an owner-authored synthetic plan.
Prior Source384 or live-planned context replicated by a deterministic administrative index.
Actual provider token savings, correctness, verifier reward or benchmark performance.

proposed_result_qualification.fixed_control_pair_qualified: All per-arm actual-current preparation, contract, final-input audit, complete usage, native effect/cleanup and matched frozen controls pass; requested treatment actually selected.
proposed_result_qualification.strict_only_metadata_changed_input_quali: Additionally the substantive pre-transform inputs match exactly or through a separately closed owner-validated administrative normalization. Fixed configs or matching task names alone do not establish this.

negative_controls_required_for_future_pr: Missing/foreign/extra metadata receipt fields, source/view/selection/reply digests and archive/helper bindings.
Boolean versus integer confusion, unknown usage null versus zero, invalid native cumulative input/cache/output arithmetic.
Requested mode drift across preparation/config/supervisor/native metadata and actual selected-mode fallback/drift.
Original @1 changed to @2, direct planning changed/removed, reply schema/suffix/model/provider/resource/setup/profile drift.
Different literal/source/core/native suffix/verdict/world facts hidden by overbroad normalization.
Complete prefix/suffix changes, original baseline contract substituted for delivered selected reply, selected bytes/hash do not match independent auditor.
More or fewer provider sessions, coding unsuccessful, plan admission failure, official verifier failure, settlement/cleanup failure.
All unsuccessful/fallback attempts keep observed native usage, incomplete/unknown flags and campaign cost; no dropping attempts or resetting prior failed audit status.
review_scope: Implementation, authored offline qualification and bounded closed metadata review; no live metadata benchmark or efficacy evaluation.

This review did not search/read private transcripts or databases. Structured receipts support recorded historical observations, not fresh current preparation; native session counter records are not API-call counts.

practical_pilot_decision.rationale: An 882-byte (1.58%) gain on an administrative host context is small relative to the previous 574,109-token full pair and does not predict session total. The earlier qualified @2 pair used 32.44% more total tokens despite a smaller initial model input.
practical_pilot_decision.next_gate: A genuine current owner census under the intended Source384/index/resource profile and retained live planning; charge that planning and all failures. If eligibility remains worthwhile, freeze both original @1 arms and implement the separately versioned receipt comparator above.

limitations: Exact restoration proves representation equality. It does not prove task semantics, numerical IEEE behavior, correctness, benchmark reward, performance or formal completeness.

Actual02 is a fresh authored administrative plan with native lexical TF-IDF indexing. It did not run LLM planning, Source384 inference/asset verification, task implementation/validation or the official verifier.
Actual02 is a host-only allocated worktree census: no container, resource allocation or production provider invocation was qualified.
The reviewer inspected only closed metadata and implementation/authored test sources. Actual private prompts/source/evaluator bodies and fresh/private databases were not read or reconstructed.
The observed DuckLake projection is inert metadata under the fresh native owner. Live Quack gateway and broad storage/backend operation remain unqualified.
Byte-derived proxy counts are not native token counts. Initial-input reductions cannot be converted into complete native-session savings.
The historical adverse@2 result is a different treatment and preserves native input variation, failed audits and full campaign cost. It does not establish the new metadata treatment's effect.
Fixed profiles do not guarantee identical fresh generated plans or native world inputs. Strict one-factor input matching has a separate qualification gate.
One completed future pair, even with lower full usage and both rewards passing, cannot establish reliable causal or repeatable savings.
All extra, unsuccessful, fallback, partial and unknown native provider usage must survive future accounting; unknown is not zero and cache is already part of input.

Actual runtime source export inventory is derived from the private recipe's required before/after equality assertion and independently checked current readback; a separate second raw source inventory was not persisted. Private recipes remain unread in this review.
